target: LRC(13): 13 distinct nonzero normalized speeds, threshold 1/14

live.name: Mandatory divisor witnesses
live.statement: For each q=2..14, some u_i is divisible by q.

live.name: Maximum-anchor resonant probe capacity
live.statement: Under unique maximal q-multiple M=qa, each v<M kills at most two anchor probes and needs gcd(v,q)=1 and v>((14-q)/q)M.

live.name: Exact 13-slot law
live.statement: |S_v(tau)| = 2 - 1_{||v tau|| <= 1/14}; two slots differ by -v^{-1} mod 13.

live.name: Eleven-resonance saturation
live.statement: If h_11=7, at least 5 of 6 outsiders have ||v tau||>3/14 at the compressed witness.

live.name: Private-probe theorem
live.statement: If h_13=6, every outsider has a deleted-runner witness with a physical 13-probe private to it.

live.name: Extremal universal saturation
live.statement: For h_13=6, every tau in W is either a 2^6+1 exact partition or a seven-pair cover with exactly one overlap.

live.name: Strict witness-measure refinement
live.statement: For M=max |a_i|, mu(W_h)>=(7-h)/7+(h-1)/(7M); in particular h=6 gives mu(W)>1/7.

live.name: Generic forced handoff
live.statement: At a generic one-runner capacity transition inside W, the created/destroyed slot is exactly the unique overlap.

live.name: Internal private witnesses
live.statement: For each internal a_j, exists tau_j with ||a_j tau_j||<1/14 and all other internal ||a_i tau_j||>=1/13.

live.name: Exact partition polynomial
live.statement: In a 2^6+1 state, the seven linear/quadratic slot factors multiply to C(X^13-X) over F_13.

live.name: Exact mixed harmonic correction
live.statement: mu(B_a(1/13) cap B_v(1/14)) = 2/91 + Bernoulli correction/(AV), with exact residue sign law.

retracted_dependency.false_edge: Counterexample for one stationary runner implies counterexample after choosing any other runner as stationary.
retracted_dependency.downstream_retracted_rounds: Target-level machinery from rounds 4-13 that requires changing reference.

retracted: Bilateral internal witness / Hall target reduction
Simultaneous all-fiber compression with changed bases
negative_gold: Generic pair-overlap alone did not close the wall.
Bare CRT/divisor coverage does not contradict the mod-13 saturation forms.
Static residue-partner skeleton can be realized without forcing target closure.
Base 1/13 separation does not prevent pair distance <1/7.
Signed Hall cancellation is false at the abstract combinatorial level.
49-base invariants with independently chosen witnesses do not provide coherence.
Single Beatty/floor packets have too much local freedom.
First moments alone do not force outsider collisions on W.
Neither mixed nor equal-threshold harmonic corrections have universal favorable sign.
No global handoff winding invariant was proved.
Essentiality of internal bad sets does not imply disjointness.

open_obligations.name: Terminal saturation family
open_obligations.statement: For each h=1..6, rule out universal 13-probe outsider coverage on W_h.

open_obligations.name: Extremal terminal saturation lemma
open_obligations.statement: Rule out h_13=6 saturated 13-cover dynamics throughout W_6.
open_obligations.effect: Would improve every counterexample to h_13<=5, but would not alone close LRC(13).
